jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
We're hiring on behalf of a Haystack partner!

The Role
• Design and own end-to-end test strategies across all levels, including unit, integration, system, UI, stress, and performance tests for medical software products.
• Build and enhance test harnesses and CI pipelines for early regression detection, ensuring stability and scalability for C++ desktop, .NET, and modern web stacks.

• Collaborate closely with development, architecture, and product management, acting as the team's quality advocate and embedding test-driven "Shift-Left" engineering practices.
• Utilize AI agents and tools to generate, maintain, and triage tests, building reusable automation skills and workflows for the QA community.

What You'll Need
• Several years of senior-level test automation experience with a deep understanding of multi-layered test frameworks and proven practice in load and performance testing.
• Excellent academic background in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a comparable technical field.
• Strong programming skills in at least one language such as C#, Java, Python, or TypeScript.
• Experience with modern test tools, version control, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Fluency in German and English, strong problem-solving skills, and a proactive, quality-driven mindset.

• Competitive salary
• Flexible hybrid work model with days in the office and remote.
• Opportunities for professional development through internal and external training programs.
• Access to employee wellness programs and benefits.

jobs.description:
Job Function

Services

Warum SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne ist ein globaler Anbieter für Software- und Cloud-Lösungen. Mit einer Präsenz in über 70 Ländern und mehr als 12.000 Mitarbeitenden unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre Software-Investitionen zu optimieren, Anwendungen zu modernisieren und das volle Potenzial von Cloud, Data und AI zu erschließen.

Was uns ausmacht, sind die Menschen bei SoftwareOne. Wir ermöglichen Zusammenarbeit über Ländergrenzen hinweg, fördern kontinuierliches Lernen und schaffen Raum für Entwicklung in einer sich ständig wandelnden Technologielandschaft. Ob dein Fokus auf Technologie, Customer Success oder Business Operations liegt – deine Ideen zählen und dein Beitrag macht einen Unterschied.

Werde Teil eines globalen Teams, in dem du deine Fähigkeiten weiterentwickelst, mit führenden Technologien arbeitest und echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden schaffst.

Die Rolle

Suchst du eine Rolle, in der du dich tief auf komplexe Microsoft-Azure-Infrastrukturen spezialisieren und technische Entscheidungen prägen kannst?
Möchtest du nicht nur „Tickets abarbeiten“, sondern langfristig Kundenumgebungen mitgestalten, modernisieren und sicherer machen?
Bist du bereit in Enterprise Azure Umgebungen unserer Kunden der wirklich Wirkung zu erzielen?

Praktische Informationen

Standort:
Bundesweit, Deutschland | Arbeitsmodell:
Hybrid / Remote mit Vor-Ort-Einsätzen | Sprachen
:
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse | Umfang:
Vollzeit | Rufbereitschaft und gelegentliche Vor-Ort-Einsätze

In maßgeschneiderten Setups übernehmen wir den Betrieb verschiedener Infrastrukturdienste und entwickeln diese kontinuierlich weiter. Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen in den Bereichen Data Center, Storage, Backup, Windows, Linux, Virtualisierung sowie im Infrastruktur Support.

Als Azure Cloud Engineer (gn) übernimmst du technische Verantwortung für geschäftskritische Managed-Service-Umgebungen auf Microsoft Azure. Du stellst den stabilen, sicheren Betrieb sicher, analysierst Störungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Cloud-, Infrastruktur- und Entwicklungsteams nachhaltige Verbesserungen.

Betrieb, Monitoring und Optimierung komplexer Microsoft-Azure-Infrastrukturen
Analyse und Behebung anspruchsvoller Incidents sowie Ableitung nachhaltiger Maßnahmen
Automatisierung wiederkehrender Aufgaben mit PowerShell, Bash und Azure Runbooks
Administration von Azure-Netzwerken, virtuellen Maschinen, Datenbanken, Identitäten, Berechtigungen und Richtlinien
Weiterentwicklung von Monitoring, Logging, Dokumentation und Knowledge Base
Mitarbeit an Infrastructure-as-Code-Themen, insbesondere Terraform
Teilnahme an Vor-Ort-Terminen, Supporteinsätzen und 24/7-Rufbereitschaft

Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten

Du bringst eine Eigenverantwortliche, proaktive und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit und die Bereitschaft, dich in neue Technologien und angrenzende Applikations- oder Web-Service-Themen einzuarbeiten. Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb komplexer Microsoft-Azure-Umgebungen mit und hast Erfahrung in folgenden Bereichen:

Technische Schwerpunkte

Azure Infrastructure: Subscriptions, Management Groups, VMs, Netzwerke, Firewalls, VPN, Application Gateway, Private Endpoints und DNS
Azure Operations: Resource Health, Monitoring, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Update Manager und Maintenance Configurations
Datenbanken und Plattformdienste wie Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Web Apps, Container Apps und Container Registry
Identity & Security: Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Azure Policy, Privileged Identity Management und AD-Synchronisierung
Grundkenntnisse in Azure DevOps, insbesondere Repositories, Pipelines und Service Connections

Betriebssysteme und Automatisierung

Erfahrung mit Windows Server sowie Grundkenntnisse in Linux, idealerweise Red Hat Enterprise Linux oder Ubuntu
Scripting- und Automatisierungskenntnisse mit PowerShell und Bash
Kenntnisse in Kusto Query Language, JSON, ARM Templates sowie Interesse an Terraform
Kenntnisse in Active Directory Domain Services und DNS

Das haben wir zu bieten

Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind unser wichtigstes Kapital und wir setzen alles daran, dass du dich bei uns wohl fühlst:  

Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice zu arbeiten  
30 Urlaubstage sowie die Option auf ein Sabbatical  
Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten sowie persönliches Coaching und Beratung  
Engagement für Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit durch unsere DEIB-Strategie und Initiativen  
Gesundheits- und Sportangebote (z.B. Wellpass) sowie Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge  
Attraktive Zusatzleistungen wie Mitarbeitendenaktien, Empfehlungsprogramm und Corporate Benefits  
Angenehme Arbeitskultur mit freiem Dresscode und strukturiertem Onboarding inklusive Buddy 

Alle weiteren Benefits unter:  hier

Inklusion und Unterstützung

SoftwareOne lädt Menschen jeglicher Herkunft und mit unterschiedlichen Fähigkeiten herzlich dazu ein, sich bei uns zu bewerben. jobs.description:
Job Description

At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.

About The Role

At Data-Driven Care we are reshaping healthcare and social care services by providing our customers with data- driven solutions and cloud data platforms. Our teams in Product Development function consists of high-end professionals working in data science, data engineering, data modelling, data advisory, cloud solutions, security and software development. We are a growing international team of talented, continuously improving experts. With us you get to work with latest technologies, innovative new solutions and create wellbeing for the society. 

As a Senior SW developer you will have a key role in developing and designing backend and micro services for our Lifecare Data Platform in Azure. The role is not a typical backend or data role. You’ll build production services running on Kubernetes and design data pipelines in Databricks, often in the same sprint. You don’t need to be an expert in everything – but you should be solid at least in one area and genuinely curious about the other. You will be working in diverse team consisting of top-level developers and other experts.

We are looking for someone with:

Strong foundation on Java and JVM-based development
Experience with Spring Boot and REST API design
Hands-on with SQL and relational data modelling
Exposure to Scala and Python in data context
Familiarity with distributed processing concepts (especially Apache Spark)
Passion to continuously learn new things, aim higher, build great products and solve complex customer problems
Confidence to take responsibility, honesty and openness as a member of a team

It would be beneficial if you also:

Previous experience in developing data-driven solutions to health and social care is highly valued
Azure, Databricks and Terraform experience are a plus

What’s in it for you?

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host an annual ‘Keep Learning Week’, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

Could you be our new colleague?

We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Arja Oksman [arja.oksman@tieto.com]

We perform background checks on all final candidates.

We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer Java/Selenium (Freelance mogelijk)
jobs.description:
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Voor een grote Belgische overheidsinstelling zoeken we 4 Test Automation Engineers die meewerken in agile ontwikkelteams binnen een complexe enterprise-omgeving.

In deze rol draag je bij aan de softwarekwaliteit door geautomatiseerde testoplossingen te ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en onderhouden. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met ontwikkelaars, businessanalisten en andere stakeholders om testprocessen verder te versterken en te automatiseren.

Ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en onderhouden van geautomatiseerde testscripts
Opstellen en uitvoeren van geautomatiseerde testscenario’s
Integreren van testautomatisering in CI/CD-processen
Uitvoeren van API-, integratie-, regressie- en end-to-endtesten
Analyseren, documenteren en rapporteren van testresultaten
Beheren van testdata en testomgevingen
Samenwerken in multidisciplinaire agile teams
Verbeteringen voorstellen en implementeren rond kwaliteit, efficiëntie en testing

Jouw profiel

Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Test Automation Engineer.
Je hebt ervaring met Agile Testing en gestructureerde testmethodieken.
Je hebt kennis van ISTQB, TMap, STBox of vergelijkbare frameworks.
Je hebt ervaring met TDD, ATDD, BDD, Exploratory Testing en Session-Based Testing.
Je hebt een brede kennis van het volledige testproces.
Je hebt ervaring met Selenium (v4 of hoger), Cucumber / Gherkin, Rest Assured, SoapUI, Postman en Swagger.
Je hebt ervaring met Jira, Confluence, Xray, Git / GitLab, Maven, TestNG of JUnit.
Je beschikt over goede kennis van Java binnen een OO-architectuur.
Je hebt goede kennis van SQL en ervaring met testdatabeheer.
Je bent vertrouwd met XPath, CSS Selectors en Regular Expressions.
Je beschikt over goede containerisatie-ervaring met Kubernetes.
Je hebt basiskennis van Angular in een testcontext.
Je werkt zelfstandig, proactief en oplossingsgericht.
Je beschikt over sterke stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden en kritisch denkvermogen.
Je bent een teamspeler binnen agile organisaties en durft bestaande oplossingen in vraag te stellen.
Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands of Frans en hebt een goede kennis van Engels.
Tweetaligheid Nederlands/Frans is een pluspunt.
Je bent bereid om 50% in Brussel te werken.
Ervaring binnen een overheidsomgeving, kennis van Agile Scrum, ervaring als Scrum Master en ervaring binnen grote complexe organisaties zijn pluspunten.

Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. In this role you will support the design, development, testing, and release of control system software for air-cooled chillers engineered for the European market, working under general supervision. You will work on the sequences that determine how a chiller starts, stages, protects itself, and holds leaving water temperature, and on the software qualities that keep it safe, efficient, secure, and compliant with European requirements.

Dublin is where European chiller controls work comes together. You will develop software and validate on units in our own laboratory alongside mechanical, electrical, and test engineers on site, and work with the global controls, software, and connected equipment teams in York (PA), Wuxi, and Izmir. This role will report into the global controls team in York (PA) but will work out of the Dublin office.

Develops and applies an understanding of control theory and of the thermal, refrigeration, and electrical behaviour of air-cooled chillers that the control system has to manage
Works under general supervision, following defined development processes to design, implement, test, and document control software for European air-cooled chiller platforms
Develops control algorithms using MATLAB / Simulink and model-based design methods for embedded controllers, and supports their integration, verification, and release onto the chiller control platform
Develops and tunes capacity control and staging logic: compressor staging and unloading, variable speed drive operation, condenser fan speed and head pressure control, expansion valve control, and leaving water temperature regulation
Implements and verifies machine protection logic including pressure and temperature limits, freeze protection, low and high ambient operation, motor and drive protection, and safe shutdown and restart behaviour

new_jobs.description:
Senior Controls Engineer II

European Air-Cooled Chiller Engineering | Dublin, Ireland

What You Will Do

Johnson Controls has an exciting Controls Engineer II opportunity based at our Dublin, Ireland location, supporting our new European air-cooled chiller engineering organization. If you enjoy control algorithm development, model-based design, and proving control performance on real machines in the laboratory, this could be the right position for you.

In this role you will support the design, development, testing, and release of control system software for air-cooled chillers engineered for the European market, working under general supervision. You will work on the sequences that determine how a chiller starts, stages, protects itself, and holds leaving water temperature, and on the software qualities that keep it safe, efficient, secure, and compliant with European requirements.

Dublin is where European chiller controls work comes together. You will develop software and validate on units in our own laboratory alongside mechanical, electrical, and test engineers on site, and work with the global controls, software, and connected equipment teams in York (PA), Wuxi, and Izmir. This role will report into the global controls team in York (PA) but will work out of the Dublin office.

How You Will Do It

Develops and applies an understanding of control theory and of the thermal, refrigeration, and electrical behaviour of air-cooled chillers that the control system has to manage
Works under general supervision, following defined development processes to design, implement, test, and document control software for European air-cooled chiller platforms
Develops control algorithms using MATLAB / Simulink and model-based design methods for embedded controllers, and supports their integration, verification, and release onto the chiller control platform
Develops and tunes capacity control and staging logic: compressor staging and unloading, variable speed drive operation, condenser fan speed and head pressure control, expansion valve control, and leaving water temperature regulation
Implements and verifies machine protection logic including pressure and temperature limits, freeze protection, low and high ambient operation, motor and drive protection, and safe shutdown and restart behaviour
Applies European machinery and electrical safety requirements to control system design, including the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC and the Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 that replaces it from 20 January 2027, EN 60204-1, and functional safety assessment of safety-related control functions to EN ISO 13849-1 and EN IEC 62061 as applicable
